questions.prompt_en: A square is turned so it looks like a diamond. Is it still a square? Explain using properties.
questions.prompt_cn: 把一个正方形转动后，看起来像“菱形”。它还是正方形吗？请用图形性质解释。
questions.expected_core: Yes; rotation does not change equal sides or four right angles.
follow_ups: What properties must every square have?

questions.prompt_en: Can a square also be a rectangle? Explain using the definition of a rectangle.
questions.prompt_cn: 正方形也可以是长方形吗？请根据长方形的定义解释。
questions.expected_core: Yes; a square has four right angles and therefore satisfies the rectangle definition.
follow_ups: Can every rectangle be a square?

questions.prompt_en: For a cube, what is a face, an edge and a vertex? How can you count hidden features too?
questions.prompt_cn: 对于正方体，什么是面、棱和顶点？怎样把看不见的部分也数进去？
questions.expected_core: Faces are surfaces, edges are where faces meet, and vertices are corner points; reason from the solid's structure.

questions.prompt_en: Two sloping lines never meet. Can they be parallel even though they are not horizontal? Explain.
questions.prompt_cn: 两条倾斜的直线永不相交。虽然它们不是水平线，它们可以平行吗？请解释。
questions.expected_core: Yes; parallel describes the relationship between the lines, not their orientation.

questions.prompt_en: A circle has radius 4 cm. What is its diameter? Explain why.
questions.prompt_cn: 一个圆的半径是4厘米。直径是多少？为什么？
questions.expected_core: 8 cm; a diameter through the centre is two radii.

questions.prompt_en: If an acute angle is rotated on the page without changing its opening, can it become obtuse? Explain.
questions.prompt_cn: 把一个锐角整体转动，但不改变张开程度，它会变成钝角吗？请解释。
questions.expected_core: No; angle type depends on angle size, not orientation.

questions.prompt_en: How can you test whether a proposed line is really a line of symmetry?
questions.prompt_cn: 怎样判断一条线是否真的是图形的对称轴？
questions.expected_core: Corresponding points must match under reflection and be equal distances from the line.

questions.prompt_en: A triangle is translated 4 squares right and 2 up. What must stay exactly the same?
questions.prompt_cn: 一个三角形向右平移4格、向上平移2格。哪些特征必须完全不变？
questions.expected_core: Shape, size and orientation stay the same; every point moves the same displacement.

questions.prompt_en: What information is needed to describe one exact rotation?
questions.prompt_cn: 要准确描述一次旋转，需要哪些信息？
questions.expected_core: Centre of rotation, direction and angle/amount of turn.
